definition: A free-text summary describing the event, situation, or record.
The skos:Concept URI this metric, dimension, or attribute realises. Multiple metrics may share a single concept_uri when they measure the same underlying notion through different operationalisations.
The LinkML range or external code list URI that constrains the values of a dimension or attribute. Named 'value_range' rather than 'range' to avoid shadowing the LinkML keyword.

The canonical URI of the code list that supplies permissible values for this dimension or attribute. May be a PublicSchema vocabulary URI or an SDMX agency codelist URN (e.g., urn:sdmx:org.sdmx.infomodel.codelist.Codelist=SDMX:CL_AREA(2.1)).
Whether this dimension or attribute is required on every observation.
The integer position of this dimension within the DSD. Drives column order on SDMX-CSV emission and the dimension order on observation records.
